text:
**B** is better. It meets the 200-word limit at roughly 175 words, while A runs to about 260 and breaks the explicit constraint.

B also ranks the issues better. It puts the GST-inclusive pricing question first, since it could cause real overcharging. A leaves it as the last item. B's other points (input mutation, validation, server-side recomputation, discount matching, formatting) are sound and concise.

A has some weaker content. Its rounding advice, `Math.round(subtotalCents * 10 / 100)`, is still floating-point and doesn't fix anything. It also pads the list with lower-value items such as the hardcoded discount code and the per-line versus total GST question.

**B**
